record_title: Flat s-number profile for translation-invariant operators on sequence spaces
provenance: A disjoint-translate argument produces a 1-complemented classical sequence subspace on which a translation-invariant operator is bounded below arbitrarily close to its full norm. This yields exact Bernstein and strictly-singular ideal bounds; finite-codimensional intersection and finite-dimensional tail arguments give the Gelfand and Kolmogorov equalities.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Maximal noncompactness and essential-norm equality for broad translation-invariant sequence-space operators on Z^d are prior art and are not claimed as new. The closest 2024 article was not exhaustively inspected at full-text theorem level, leaving residual overlap risk. The theorem is restricted to same-space operators on l_p(G), 1<=p<infinity, and c_0(G), and does not cover l_infinity(G).
